steps.name: Reproduce HadCRUT5 200-member trend distribution and verify source hashes
steps.body:
run: |
          SNAP="data/noema-003/hadcrut5-5.2.0.0"
          python scripts/analyze_hadcrut_ensemble.py \
            --input "$SNAP/HadCRUT.5.2.0.0.analysis.ensemble_series.global.annual.csv" \
            --summary-csv "$SNAP/HadCRUT.5.2.0.0.analysis.summary_series.global.annual.csv" \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hadcrut5-ensemble-results.json"
          python - "$RUNNER_TEMP/hadcrut5-ensemble-results.json" <<'PY'
          import hashlib
          import json
          from pathlib import Path
          import sys

          root = Path("data/noema-003/hadcrut5-5.2.0.0")
          manifest = json.loads((root / "source-manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
          for filename, metadata in manifest["files"].items():
              actual_hash = hashlib.sha256((root / filename).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
              if actual_hash != metadata["sha256"]:
                  raise SystemExit(f"HadCRUT5 source hash mismatch: {filename}")
          expected = json.loads((root / "ensemble-trend-results-1979-2025.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
          actual = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
          if actual != expected:
              import difflib
              expected_text = json.dumps(expected, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True).splitlines()
              actual_text = json.dumps(actual, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True).splitlines()
              print("\\n".join(difflib.unified_diff(expected_text, actual_text, fromfile="pinned", tofile="generated")))
              raise SystemExit("HadCRUT5 generated ensemble results differ from pinned results")
          print("HadCRUT5 5.2.0.0 source hashes and 200-member results match")
          PY

steps.name: Reproduce NOEMA-005 summation experiment and compare frozen results
steps.body:
run: |
          python scripts/simulate_noema005_summation.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/noema005-results.json"
          python - "$RUNNER_TEMP/noema005-results.json" <<'PY'
          import json
          from pathlib import Path
          import sys

          expected = json.loads(Path("data/noema-005/floating-summation-results.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
          actual = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
          # Runtime/platform metadata is recorded for provenance but is not
          # expected to match across independent CI runner images.
          expected.pop("environment", None)
          actual.pop("environment", None)
          if actual != expected:
              import difflib
              expected_text = json.dumps(expected, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True).splitlines()
              actual_text = json.dumps(actual, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True).splitlines()
              print("\\n".join(difflib.unified_diff(
                  expected_text, actual_text, fromfile="frozen", tofile="generated"
              )))
              raise SystemExit("NOEMA-005 generated summation results differ from frozen results")
          print("NOEMA-005 summation results match the frozen snapshot")
          PY

          DB="$RUNNER_TEMP/noema-ops.sqlite3"
          BACKUP="$RUNNER_TEMP/noema-ops-backup.sqlite3"
          RESTORED="$RUNNER_TEMP/noema-ops-restored.sqlite3"
          python -m noema_core.jobs_cli --db "$DB" metrics
          python -m noema_core.jobs_cli --db "$DB" backup --output "$BACKUP"
          python -m noema_core.jobs_cli restore --source "$BACKUP" --destination "$RESTORED"
          python -m noema_core.jobs_cli --db "$RESTORED" verify
          python -m noema_core.jobs_cli --db "$RESTORED" metrics

steps.body:
run: |
          BASE="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/christianbentz/PaleoSigns/b376bd87d9676fbf63f8555d03e06b4c28113740/data/signBase"
          curl --fail --location --silent --show-error "$BASE/Sb2Artifact-2025-03-06.csv" --output /tmp/signbase-objects.csv
          curl --fail --location --silent --show-error "$BASE/Sign-2025-03-06.csv" --output /tmp/signbase-signs.csv
          python scripts/audit_signbase.py \
            --artifacts /tmp/signbase-objects.csv \
            --dictionary /tmp/signbase-signs.csv \
            --output /tmp/signbase-audit.json
          diff -u data/audits/signbase-v2-audit-2026-11-23.json /tmp/signbase-audit.json
